blind_test_research_goal.note: These are project goals, not guarantees. The final paper must report the frozen result even if a goal is missed.

experiment_order.action: Generate fresh matched legal-control/attack runs and freeze metadata manifests.
Audit pair alignment, labels, splits, hard-control coverage, and forbidden metadata leakage.
Train unchanged B3-count4 on the new dataset with multiple seeds.
Train the zero-parameter matched-pair graph-margin variants using the frozen margin search.
Select dataset/model variant using validation graph balanced accuracy, FPR, recall, and localization metrics.
Freeze one checkpoint and all thresholds.
Authorize and execute exactly one fresh blind-test pass.

priority_categories.K4: weakest strict all-task exact category in P2-C1

attack_coverage.strengths: Include low, medium, and high attack strengths, with special emphasis on low-strength attacks overlapping hard legitimate traffic.
attack_coverage.victims: Retain one- and multi-victim cases when supported by the simulator and labels.

balance_contract.hard_control_emphasis: Hard legitimate controls must form a substantial, explicitly reported portion of every non-test split.
balance_contract.pair_balance: one ATTACK and one CONTROL member per pair
balance_contract.scenario_balance: No single legitimate family, attack count, strength, victim placement, or router placement may dominate training or validation.

required: edge, corner, and interior transit routers
all router IDs represented where physically possible

matched_pair_rule.pair_alignment: Use common-prefix chronological windows with identical ordered starts for ATTACK and CONTROL.

required_legitimate_control_families.purpose: teach high utilization without malicious injection
separate legal bursts from attack onset
cover legitimate concentration near shared resources
cover persistent false-alarm episodes around workload transitions

fresh_dataset_contract.source_rule: Generate entirely fresh simulation runs. No P2 test tensor, P2 test window, or reconstructed P2 test feature may be copied into training, validation, or development analysis.

split_contract.scenario_holdout: Validation and final blind test must contain complete unseen scenario families or workload/mapping groups, not merely later windows from training runs.
split_contract.split_unit: matched simulation pair/run family, never individual windows
split_contract.test_policy: Do not enumerate or deserialize the new blind-test tensors before checkpoint and thresholds are frozen.

topology_scope.reason: Resolve the 4x4 regional-expert discrimination problem before replication to larger meshes.

model_revision_contract.baseline_first: First retrain the unchanged 43,273-parameter B3 model on the fresh dataset. This isolates dataset improvement from architecture improvement.

count_head.reason: P2 frozen blind-test active-count accuracy is 1.0.

localization_priority.allowed_change: scenario balancing and modest loss-weight ablation
localization_priority.forbidden: sacrificing graph false-positive control to inflate transit metrics

primary_revision.name: B3_COUNT4_PLUS_MATCHED_PAIR_GRAPH_MARGIN
primary_revision.reason: Directly increases separation between matched attacks and hard legitimate controls without adding hardware.
primary_revision.selection_rule: Choose the margin using validation only; freeze the search space before training.
primary_revision.training_only_objective: For every aligned ATTACK/CONTROL pair-window block, enforce attack_logit >= control_logit + margin.

secondary_revision_candidates.constraint: must be compared against the unchanged-B3 and matched-margin baselines
secondary_revision_candidates.name: control_false_positive_asymmetric_graph_loss
secondary_revision_candidates.purpose: penalize false-positive controls more strongly while preserving attack recall

secondary_revision_candidates.name: graph_node_evidence_consistency_regularization
secondary_revision_candidates.purpose: discourage graph attack predictions when source/path heads provide no coherent attack evidence

prohibited_actions: Do not retrain on or copy P2 blind-test tensors/windows.
Do not retune the frozen P2 checkpoint or thresholds.
Do not use IDs, profiles, mappings, strengths, seeds, or split metadata as learned inputs.
Do not start with a larger architecture before establishing the unchanged-B3 fresh-dataset baseline.
Do not redesign the count head.
Do not use a two-stage detector/localizer as the primary system.
Do not inspect the new blind-test contents before authorization.

root_cause.interpretation: The main failure is persistent, broad false-positive activation on legitimate/control traffic. The next revision must improve legal/control-versus-attack separation before increasing model capacity.

security_boundary.contract_source: P2-C1 frozen interpretation report and lock only

terminology.hard_legitimate_control: Fresh benign NoC traffic that produces congestion, hotspots, bursts, backpressure, or phase changes without any malicious injection.
terminology.legal_control_note: The project shorthand 'legal NoC traffic' means legitimate or benign control traffic, not a legal/compliance category.
